chunks.title: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP)
chunks.content: Authority: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP). Primary Statute: Companies Act 2017. Portal: eServices (eservices.secp.gov.pk). Regulatory Mandate: Corporate incorporation, corporate filings, single member company regulation, and director accountability.

chunks.title: Federal Board of Revenue (FBR)
chunks.content: Authority: Federal Board of Revenue (FBR). Primary Statute: Income Tax Ordinance 2001. Portal: Iris (iris.fbr.gov.pk). Regulatory Mandate: National Tax Number (NTN) registration, Active Taxpayer List (ATL), federal sales tax on goods, and withholding tax management.

chunks.title: Pakistan Software Export Board (PSEB)
chunks.statute: Income Tax Ordinance 2001 (Section 154A) & PSEB Policy Guidelines
chunks.content: Authority: Pakistan Software Export Board (PSEB). Primary Statute: Income Tax Ordinance 2001 (Section 154A) & PSEB Policy Guidelines. Portal: pseb.org.pk. Regulatory Mandate: Facilitation of IT & ITeS exporters, IT freelancer registration, and certification for 0.25% concessionary export tax credit.

chunks.title: Punjab Revenue Authority (PRA)
chunks.statute: Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act 2012
chunks.content: Authority: Punjab Revenue Authority (PRA). Primary Statute: Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act 2012. Portal: pra.punjab.gov.pk. Regulatory Mandate: Levy and collection of provincial sales tax on services (16% standard, reduced rates on IT) rendered in Punjab.

chunks.title: Sindh Revenue Board (SRB)
chunks.statute: Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act 2011
chunks.content: Authority: Sindh Revenue Board (SRB). Primary Statute: Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act 2011. Portal: srb.gos.pk. Regulatory Mandate: Levy and collection of provincial sales tax on services (13% standard, 3% on IT) rendered in Sindh.

chunks.title: Deadline: Annual Income Tax Return (Individuals & AOPs)
chunks.content: Compliance Event: Annual Income Tax Return (Individuals & AOPs). Statutory Deadline: September 30 each year. Legal Consequences of Non-Compliance: Removal from Active Taxpayer List (ATL), leading to 100% higher withholding tax deductions on banking and business transactions.

chunks.title: Deadline: Annual Income Tax Return (Companies / Pvt Ltd)
chunks.content: Compliance Event: Annual Income Tax Return (Companies / Pvt Ltd). Statutory Deadline: December 31 each year (for tax year ending June 30). Legal Consequences of Non-Compliance: Financial penalties under Section 182 and suspension of tax certificates.

chunks.title: Deadline: Monthly Withholding Tax Statement
chunks.content: Compliance Event: Monthly Withholding Tax Statement. Statutory Deadline: 15th of every succeeding month. Legal Consequences of Non-Compliance: Penalties for non-filing of withholding tax statements under Section 165.

chunks.title: Deadline: Mandatory Record Retention
chunks.content: Compliance Event: Mandatory Record Retention. Statutory Deadline: Minimum 6 years from end of tax year. Legal Consequences of Non-Compliance: Disallowance of business expense deductions under audit (Section 174).

chunks.title: Contract Trap: Vague termination rights or notice periods
chunks.content: Risk Category: Vague termination rights or notice periods. Severity: High Risk. Legal Details: Contracts using phrases like 'reasonable notice' without defining exact calendar days (e.g. 30, 60, or 90 days), allowing arbitrary eviction or abrupt cancellation.

chunks.title: Contract Trap: Unclear payment terms or late-payment consequences
chunks.content: Risk Category: Unclear payment terms or late-payment consequences. Severity: High Risk. Legal Details: Agreements lacking defined payment milestones, bank details, grace periods, or containing vague penalty threats like 'landlord/client may take appropriate action'.

chunks.title: Contract Trap: Unilateral price/fee changes
chunks.content: Risk Category: Unilateral price/fee changes. Severity: High Risk. Legal Details: Clauses permitting one party to increase prices, fees, or rent without requiring mutual written consent or signed change-orders.

chunks.title: Contract Trap: Auto-renewal without clear notice requirements
chunks.content: Risk Category: Auto-renewal without clear notice requirements. Severity: Medium Risk. Legal Details: Locking the business into an automatic annual renewal unless canceled within a tiny, easily missed window, often accompanied by uncapped rent or rate spikes.

chunks.title: Contract Trap: Unclear ownership of intellectual property
chunks.content: Risk Category: Unclear ownership of intellectual property. Severity: High Risk. Legal Details: Client pays for custom software or creative deliverables but only receives a limited 'right to use', while the vendor retains all underlying code ownership.

chunks.title: Contract Trap: Broad or unclear liability/indemnity clauses
chunks.content: Risk Category: Broad or unclear liability/indemnity clauses. Severity: High Risk. Legal Details: One-sided clauses forcing the small business to indemnify the other party for unlimited damages, or capping the other party's liability to an ambiguous amount.

chunks.title: Contract Trap: Confidentiality and business-data handling not clearly defined
chunks.content: Risk Category: Confidentiality and business-data handling not clearly defined. Severity: Medium Risk. Legal Details: Permitting broad third-party disclosures or failing to mandate strict deletion of proprietary data, credentials, and customer records upon contract expiry.

chunks.title: Contract Trap: Unclear subcontracting/third-party access
chunks.content: Risk Category: Unclear subcontracting/third-party access. Severity: Medium Risk. Legal Details: Allowing the contractor to pass confidential work to unknown subcontractors without obtaining prior written client consent.

chunks.title: Contract Trap: Missing scope, deliverables or acceptance criteria
chunks.content: Risk Category: Missing scope, deliverables or acceptance criteria. Severity: High Risk. Legal Details: Agreements leaving project scope to be 'discussed later as business needs arise', guaranteeing scope creep and unpaid revisions.

chunks.title: Contract Trap: Tax/withholding responsibilities not clearly specified
chunks.content: Risk Category: Tax/withholding responsibilities not clearly specified. Severity: High Risk. Legal Details: Failing to specify whether amounts are gross or net of applicable FBR withholding tax (Section 153/155) and provincial sales tax (PRA/SRB), causing unexpected financial deductions.

chunks.title: What should I check before signing a commercial lease?
chunks.statute: Punjab Rented Premises Act 2009 / Islamabad Rent Restriction Ordinance / Income Tax Ordinance 2001 (Section 155)
chunks.content: Question: What should I check before signing a commercial lease?. Legal Guidance: Verify 6 critical points: exact written termination notice (60-90 days), clear maintenance separation (structural vs operational), renewal rent increase cap (8-10%), security deposit refund terms, municipal commercial zoning, and Section 155 tax withholding allocation.. Governing Legal Basis: Punjab Rented Premises Act 2009 / Islamabad Rent Restriction Ordinance / Income Tax Ordinance 2001 (Section 155)

chunks.title: Can I terminate this contract early, and what notice is required?
chunks.content: Question: Can I terminate this contract early, and what notice is required?. Legal Guidance: Early termination depends on your contract clause. Avoid 'reasonable notice' and specify exact days. For breach of contract, a 14-30 day formal Notice to Cure is legally required before termination.. Governing Legal Basis: Contract Act 1872 (Sections 39, 73, 75) & Specific Relief Act 1877

chunks.title: Who is responsible for taxes or withholding on this payment?
chunks.statute: Income Tax Ordinance 2001 (Sections 152, 153, 155) & Provincial Sales Tax on Services Acts
chunks.content: Question: Who is responsible for taxes or withholding on this payment?. Legal Guidance: Every business is responsible for its own income tax. However, corporate payers are legally mandated by FBR to withhold tax at source (e.g. 8-11% on services, scaled rates on rent). Contracts should state whether amounts are inclusive or exclusive of taxes.. Governing Legal Basis: Income Tax Ordinance 2001 (Sections 152, 153, 155) & Provincial Sales Tax on Services Acts

chunks.title: What records should my business maintain for tax purposes?
chunks.statute: Income Tax Ordinance 2001, Section 174 & Income Tax Rules 2002 (Rule 29)
chunks.content: Question: What records should my business maintain for tax purposes?. Legal Guidance: Under Section 174, maintain serially numbered sales invoices, vendor receipts, utility bills, business bank account statements, and salary payment CPRs for a minimum of 6 years.. Governing Legal Basis: Income Tax Ordinance 2001, Section 174 & Income Tax Rules 2002 (Rule 29)

chunks.title: What registrations or compliance steps apply to my business?
chunks.statute: FBR Iris Guidelines / SECP Companies Act 2017 / PSEB Policy Guidelines
chunks.content: Question: What registrations or compliance steps apply to my business?. Legal Guidance: A 4-tier structure: (1) FBR Iris NTN, (2) Entity registration (SECP or Registrar of Firms), (3) Provincial Sales Tax on Services (PRA/SRB), and (4) Sectoral licensing (PSEB for IT exporters to claim 0.25% tax rate).. Governing Legal Basis: FBR Iris Guidelines / SECP Companies Act 2017 / PSEB Policy Guidelines
